definitions.meaning: The (1,2) normalized slice attached to a cubic hyperplane meeting the twisted cubic in three distinct points.
The Dubouloz-Finston normal form for the indicated principal additive bundle over the punctured affine plane.

statement.latex: \begin{gathered}X_{\mathrm{transverse}}\simeq X(4,4,-a^3+a^2b^2-b^3),\\[t]=-{1\over ab^4}+{1\over a^2b^2}-{1\over a^4b}\in H^1(\mathbb A^2\setminus\{0\},\mathcal O),\\X_{\mathrm{transverse}}\not\simeq\operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb C).\end{gathered}
statement.natural: Every transverse normalized linear-quadratic slice is isomorphic to X(4,4,-a^3+a^2b^2-b^3), the nontrivial G_a-bundle over A^2 minus {0} represented by the Cech cocycle -1/(ab^4)+1/(a^2b^2)-1/(a^4b). Its total space is an exotic affine three-sphere and is not algebraically isomorphic to SL_2(C).
quantifiers: for every transverse normalized linear-quadratic slice
